decks.notes: This deck focuses on aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent's life total. By using cheap, efficient creatures like Goblin Bushwhacker and Voldaren Epicure along with powerful burn spells such as Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize. Cards like Kuldotha Rebirth and Experimental Synthesizer provide additional threats and ways to generate value. This deck's strategy is to apply pressure early and maintain it throughout the game in order to secure a quick victory.

The main concept of this deck is to create a combo using the Sadistic Glee enchantment in combination with cards like Writhing Chrysalis and Basking Broodscale to generate a powerful advantage. The deck also includes cards like Deadly Dispute and Eviscerator's Insight to control the board and provide card advantage. Additionally, Tamiyo's Safekeeping helps protect key creatures and prevent the opponent from targeting important pieces of the combo. Overall, the deck aims to efficiently assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with its synergy and power.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt your opponent's strategy through a combination of counterspells, removal, and card draw. By efficiently controlling the board and limiting your opponent's options, you can gain an advantage and eventually out-value them to secure the win. The deck utilizes a mix of creatures like Sneaky Snacker and Gurmag Angler, along with card draw spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to maintain a steady stream of resources. The inclusion of disruptive spells like Spell Pierce and Snuff Out further enhances your ability to control the game.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and apply pressure on the opponent through aggressive creature and removal spells. The deck also includes a mix of card draw and graveyard interaction to maintain card advantage and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the deck utilizes a variety of mana fixing and lands to ensure consistency in casting spells. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of efficient threats and disruption while maintaining a solid mana base for consistency.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and removal spells. By utilizing the graveyard synergies with cards like Deadly Dispute and Ichor Wellspring, the deck is able to maintain a steady stream of threats while disrupting the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of artifacts like Blood Fountain and Galvanic Blast adds extra reach and versatility to the deck. Additionally, the mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements while also providing some utility with land destruction effects from Cleansing Wildfire.

The core strategy of this deck is to quickly develop a board presence with aggressive creatures such as Nyxborn Hydra and Krark-Clan Shaman, supported by removal spells like Cast Down and Galvanic Blast. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Nihil Spellbomb and Cleansing Wildfire, while generating card advantage with Ichor Wellspring and Deadly Dispute. The mana base is optimized for consistency and allows for efficient mana usage with various colored spells. The overall goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and disruption.

This Mono Black Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with low-cost creatures and efficient removal spells. The deck aims to maintain a steady flow of creatures to the battlefield while disrupting opponent's game plan with removal spells like Tragic Slip and Snuff Out. Reaping the Graves provides the opportunity to return multiple creatures from the graveyard to hand, allowing for additional pressure. The deck also includes enablers like Mortician Beetle and Serrated Scorpion to benefit from sacrificing creatures. With a low mana curve and aggressive strategy, this deck aims to win swiftly and decisively.

This deck focuses on using low-cost creatures and counterspells to maintain board control and pressure the opponent early in the game. By efficiently using faeries and other creatures, the deck aims to tempo the opponent and disrupt their strategy. Additionally, the deck includes card draw spells to maintain consistency and keep up the aggression. The mono blue color ensures a streamlined mana base and allows for easy access to counterspells to protect the aggro creatures. With a focus on speed and disruption, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly.

This deck focuses on quickly building up a large board presence of artifact creatures and using various sacrifice and draw mechanics to maintain card advantage and deal damage to the opponent. By utilizing cheap artifacts and efficient removal spells, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of aggressive plays while also disrupting their game plan with targeted removal and card draw. The synergy between the artifact creatures and sacrifice/draw effects allows for a fast-paced and strategic gameplay that can catch opponents off guard and secure victory.

The deck focuses on quickly establishing a board presence with efficient and cheap creature spells like Delver of Secrets and Cryptic Serpent, backed up with disruptive spells like Counterspell and Force Spike to control the game. Utilizing cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to dig for threats and disruption, the deck aims to create constant pressure on the opponent while maintaining card advantage with cards like Thought Scour and Deep Analysis. The deck also includes bounce spells like Boomerang for tempo advantage and finishers like Murmuring Mystic and Dragon Wings to close out the game.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and apply pressure on the opponent through a combination of low-cost creatures and disruptive spells. The deck focuses on efficiently using cards like Delver of Secrets and Cryptic Serpent to deal damage while countering the opponent's spells with Counterspell and Spell Pierce. Additionally, card draw spells like Brainstorm and Deep Analysis help to maintain hand advantage and ensure consistent threats on the board. The deck also utilizes bounce spells like Boomerang to disrupt the opponent's board and create favorable combat situations.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quickly and aggressively dealing damage to the opponent through efficient creatures and burn spells. With a combination of low-cost creatures like Voldaren Epicure and Sneaky Snacker, along with direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast, this deck aims to apply constant pressure and end the game swiftly. Additionally, cards like Faithless Looting and Grab the Prize help maintain card advantage and selective card draw, while Alms of the Vein provides additional reach for finishing off opponents. The deck also includes some utility lands like Bojuka Bog for graveyard hate and Jagged Barrens for mana fixing.

The main concept of this deck is to create a combo with Sadistic Glee and other cards such as Writhing Chrysalis and Malevolent Rumble to generate advantage and control the game. The deck also includes cards like Deadly Dispute and Duress to disrupt the opponent's strategy while using Basking Broodscale and Nadier's Nightblade for additional threats. The mana base is focused on ensuring consistent color access while supporting the combo pieces. Overall, the deck aims to create a powerful synergy between its cards to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

This deck focuses on combining various creature abilities to generate value and card advantage, while also removing threats with removal spells like Snuff Out. Sadistic Glee is a key card that allows for powerful combos by sacrificing creatures and pumping others up. The deck includes protection spells like Snakeskin Veil and Tamiyo's Safekeeping to secure the combo pieces. Khalni Garden and Ichor Wellspring provide additional creatures and resources, while the rest of the cards support the main strategy of getting maximum value from sacrificing and recurring creatures.

This UR Control deck aims to control the game through a combination of counter spells, removal, and creature token generation. Using cards like Counterspell and Dispel to control the opponent's spells, while utilizing cards like Lightning Bolt and Skred for removal. Murmuring Mystic and Tolarian Terror provide additional threats on the board, while cards like Brainstorm and Ponder help with card selection. The deck also includes mana fixing with Seething Landscape and Volatile Fjord, alongside snow-covered lands for synergy with Skred. Overall, this deck focuses on controlling the game while setting up for a win condition.

This UR Control deck focuses on efficiently controlling the opponent's resources through counter spells like Counterspell and Dispel, while also using removal spells like Skred and Lightning Bolt to maintain board control. The deck also aims to generate card advantage through cantrips like Brainstorm, Ponder, and Preordain, as well as creating threats with cards like Murmuring Mystic and Tolarian Terror. It utilizes snow lands for synergy with cards like Lórien Revealed and Perilous Landscape, allowing for flexibility in mana generation. Overall, the deck aims to out-value and outplay the opponent through smart decision-making and efficient removal.
